transcript.text: gas hob keeps clickin on its own since i cleand it, stops then starts agen. drivin me mad. pls help

This is usually moisture left around a burner cap, electrode or ignition control after cleaning, rather than a gas-supply fault. Turn all knobs to off and isolate the hob at its cooker switch/fused spur; do not use it while it is clicking by itself. Once cool, lift off each burner cap and its metal crown, dry them and the area beneath with kitchen roll, gently wipe the white ceramic spark tips, then refit every piece so it sits completely flat. Leave it isolated for a few hours, preferably overnight, to dry out before trying it again.

ok did it. unpluged the hob at the plug in the cupboard under the sink for the afternoon and the clicking has stopped. one cap was a bit wonky so i put it back flat, and wiped some grease off. no gas smell btw

That points strongly to moisture or grease around the ignition area, with the off-centre burner cap likely contributing. Cleaning and reseating the cap, it is safe to regard that as resolved. For future cleaning, avoid flooding the burner tops and let the caps and igniter area dry fully before switching the hob back on. If it starts clicking by itself again when dry and clean, isolate it and arrange a gas-appliance engineer, as the ignition switch or spark unit may then be sticking.
